description: Log in to TradeStaq with email and password and store the returned access token locally. Simple credential login for automation and headless use; for interactive users prefer authenticate (browser OAuth, where credentials never enter the chat). Credentials are sent directly to the TradeStaq API over HTTPS and are not persisted — only the returned token is saved.

email.description: The user's TradeStaq account email address.

password.description: The user's TradeStaq password. Sent to the API over HTTPS; never stored.

name: login
